procedure: Wait for root final acceptance. Commit only the current reviewed workspace simplification/runtime+fixtures and its required evidence; never stage node_modules, private files or unfinished G7.

Bind a fresh release ledger to exact final target SHA, published baseline659cab8, this worktree, site/account IDs and one-build cap. Do not reuse a closed prior helper ledger or its historical authorization.

Check target is a descendant of the published baseline, working tree has no tracked changes, runtime hashes match acceptance, and the complete gate has passed at target. Existing main elsewhere contains unrelated changes and is not a release source.

Use a fresh, separately scoped read-only release preflight if current metadata has aged or changed. Confirm the remote main tip still equals the expected baseline and no pending target/site build exists. Never force a changed remote.

Reserve the sole push in the fresh ledger, then from this worktree run git push origin EXACT_ACCEPTED_SHA:refs/heads/main (no force). This triggers the one automatic production build. Do not invoke netlify deploy, a build hook or manual deploy.
On any ambiguous push result, inspect exact remote/deploy state read-only; never blindly repeat the push or trigger a manual fallback.

Bound metadata polling under the fresh release phase, then require getSite.published_deploy READY at the exact target and exactly one matching completed build with no error before reporting published.

Run separately bounded read-only hosted resource/health acceptance for this full accumulated batch. Netlify Pretty URLs can rewrite HTML anchors; compare against the known allowed transformation and exact non-HTML source hashes. No real signup, model, email, call, SMS, Google or billing test is implied by publication.
